cover: Nationwide riots shake France while massive drone strikes hit Russian oil refineries
cover_scene: A burning Parisian avenue obscured by heavy tear gas and riot police facing silhouettes of protesters against distant refinery fires

slides.scene: A Parisian boulevard at dusk choked with tear gas and burning barricades, riot police forming a wall of shields against turbulent crowds with French tricolor flags visible
slides.headline: Over 1,800 arrested in France riots
slides.body: Violent protests over living costs and social security erupted across French cities, leading to widespread looting and more than 1,800 arrests. President Emmanuel Macron condemned the unrest, while authorities struggle to restore order following extensive urban destruction.

slides.scene: Industrial fuel storage tanks engulfed in massive fireballs under night sky filled with flashing anti-aircraft fire and drone trails
slides.headline: Ukraine strikes St Petersburg oil refineries
slides.body: Ukraine launched a barrage of over 1,000 drones across Russian territory, igniting large fires at critical oil facilities in Saint Petersburg. The attack killed at least one person, marking a deep strategic escalation against Moscow's energy infrastructure.

slides.scene: A fortified government district under high alert with distant smoke plumes rising across a desert metropolis landscape
slides.headline: Saudi Arabia issues high-rise shelter warnings
slides.body: Saudi authorities ordered skyscraper workers home following heightened security threats from Yemen's Houthis. The advisory follows intensified border clashes, including the crash of a Saudi military helicopter in Najran that killed two crew members.

slides.scene: Emergency response vehicles with flashing sirens surrounding smoking barrack facilities at a remote Canadian military installation under gray skies
slides.headline: Fatal blaze at Canadian military base
slides.body: A major incident and fire broke out at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, causing multiple confirmed deaths and injuries. Defense officials launched an investigation into the cause as emergency teams contained extensive structural damage.

slides.scene: An ornate Indian temple complex surrounded by vast disarray and emergency stretchers following a massive surge in Kolkata under festive floodlights
slides.headline: Deadly Kolkata stampede kills 19 people
slides.body: A severe crowd crush at a religious gathering in Kolkata left at least 19 devotees dead and dozens injured. Emergency responders rushed victims to hospitals, reigniting scrutiny over safety protocols during large public gatherings across India.
